title: Nexus / Infrastructure
description: Per-container CPU, memory, network, and disk IO (docs/build-phases.md Phase 17, task 17.12) — the piece application-level /metrics never covers. Sourced from cAdvisor (pointed at containerd directly — see docker-compose.observability.yml's cadvisor service comment for why) and joined against docker-label-exporter's own id->name mapping (task 17.15), since containerd's "moby" namespace doesn't carry Docker's own container name/compose labels. The join is also what scopes this dashboard to this project's own containers: docker-label-exporter is server-side filtered by the Docker Engine API itself, so a container it was never told about simply has no `id` to join against and drops out of every query below. Only containers actually running show up — nexusd/signerd need `make docker-up` (docker-compose.yml's --profile app), not `make run`, to appear here at all.

panels.title: CPU usage (cores)
panels.description: rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total[5m]) — fraction of one CPU core; 1.0 means fully saturating one core. Joined against docker-label-exporter's container_id_info for the real name (cAdvisor's own `id` label is a raw container-ID cgroup path under containerd, task 17.12's own comment on why).

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (id) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{id=~"/docker/.+"}[5m])), "id", "$1", "id", "/docker/(.+)") * on(id) group_left(name, compose_service) container_id_info{name=~"$container"}

panels.title: Memory working set
panels.description: container_memory_working_set_bytes — the memory the kernel considers actually in use (closer to what an OOM killer looks at than container_memory_usage_bytes, which also counts reclaimable page cache).

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (id) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{id=~"/docker/.+"}[5m])), "id", "$1", "id", "/docker/(.+)") * on(id) group_left(name, compose_service) container_id_info{name=~"$container"}

label_replace(sum by (id) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{id=~"/docker/.+"}[5m])), "id", "$1", "id", "/docker/(.+)") * on(id) group_left(name, compose_service) container_id_info{name=~"$container"}

label_replace(sum by (id) (rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{id=~"/docker/.+"}[5m])), "id", "$1", "id", "/docker/(.+)") * on(id) group_left(name, compose_service) container_id_info{name=~"$container"}

label_replace(sum by (id) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{id=~"/docker/.+"}[5m])), "id", "$1", "id", "/docker/(.+)") * on(id) group_left(name, compose_service) container_id_info{name=~"$container"}
